enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Shield Bashing +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to Increased chance of Secondary Shield Bash.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +2d8 damage.
Bashing 2: This shield is exceptionally durable and dense, and does an additional 2d6 damage when used to shield bash.
Riposte +2: This item enchants its user with incredible awareness and speed, granting a +2 Insight bonus to AC and to Saves.
